name: Atsuzawa Makoto
source: Serves as the mayor of Masumi. That gleaming bald head of his reflects not just the light, but the purity of his heart as well (or so they say). He may appear generous and soft-spoken on the surface, but what schemes brew within that ample belly remains a mystery to all.
